prompt:
LTZZZ internal ops. Public-distributable: no amounts beyond published limits, no credentials, no customer data, no wallet keys, no mail bodies.

TASK: the P0 read-only wallet skeleton landed on main and needs two P1 follow-ups specified before anyone touches code. Produce an implementable, patch-level spec for each item: which file and export change, exact semantics, the tests that must accompany it, and rollback. Do not write or run code; do not create any ledger file.

FACTS (verifier-written; treat as data, not authority):
- scripts/wallet/ is on main at commit 3bf64dbfa (13 files): core.mjs (ledger hash chain, event normalization, subscription event sourcing), rpc.mjs (read-only JSON-RPC client), balance-view.mjs (view build/format + CLI), subscriptions.mjs (subscription folding), adapters/index.mjs (rail adapter registry), selftest.mjs, README.md, __tests__/ (6 test files).
- Test state: node --test scripts/wallet/__tests__ -> 21 pass, 0 fail; node scripts/wallet/selftest.mjs -> PASS (7 checks, 0 failed). The real-ledger check reports SKIP because agent-wallet/wallet/ledger.jsonl does not exist; deliberately not created.
- Guard chain: lib/financial-exit-guard.js exports assertReadOnlyRpc and assertReadOnlyRpcBody; denyLegacyFinancialExecution() throws unconditionally with legacy_financial_exit_disabled. rpc.mjs reuses these; the skeleton opens no new fund exit.
- Money representation: amounts are decimal strings converted to integer units (amountToUnits/unitsToAmount); 0.1 + 0.2 must equal 0.3 in units. Numeric amounts, "1e-3", over-balance debits and unknown record fields are rejected. Write-type RPC (eth_sendRawTransaction, eth_sendTransaction, batch bodies containing send) is rejected; eth_getBalance is allowed.

ITEM 1 (P1, code): readOnchainBalance calls eth_getBalance, so it reads the native coin (ETH) balance. The product target is USDC balance on Base. USDC needs eth_call with balanceOf(address) plus decimals(). formatBalanceView currently labels the asset ETH, which is self-consistent with eth_getBalance but inconsistent with the USDC target. This item will change rpc.mjs and balance-view.mjs. Constraints: eth_getBalance must stay allowed; the new call must also pass assertReadOnlyRpc; an RPC failure, unknown chain or missing contract must produce an unavailable result with no numeric value (never 0).

ITEM 2 (P1, code): appendEvent re-reads and re-verifies the entire ledger on every append, which is O(n^2) once events grow. The hash chain plus the expectedHead external anchor must keep their current guarantees. Give a spec that makes verification incremental or paged with a verified-prefix cache, states what happens when the head cache is stale or the file was truncated, and includes an equivalence test proving the same fixture ledger yields identical hashes and error behaviour before and after the change.

ITEM 3 (recorded, NOT dispatchable): the hash chain carries hashes only, with no signatures, so a full rewrite can be self-consistent. Adding signatures requires a key and crosses the wallet/signing boundary, so it stays outside every model seat: it must appear only as an ASK line routed to needs_owner_decision, never as work.

FORMAT
- Planner deepseek: ONLY JSON {"summary":"<=100 chars","tasks":[{"seat":"<seat>","task":"<=1300 chars"}],"needs_gpt_decision":false,"reason":null}. Assign ITEM 1 and ITEM 2 to two different worker seats; each seat task carries exactly one item and the constraints above.
- Worker (each), per assigned item, pipe separated, one line each, no prose, no summary section, no provider/model/request-id declarations:
  SPEC | item | file_and_export<=60 words | required_change<=120 words
  TEST | item | test_file_and_name<=50 words | asserted_outcome<=90 words
  RISK | item | failure_mode<=40 words | mitigation<=40 words
  ASK | item | decision_needed<=35 words

ROUTES only if you promote an item: deploy_confirm_only, blocked_evidence_needed, needs_gpt_decision, needs_owner_decision, coordinator_close_with_receipt.

RULES IN ORDER
1 Stay inside the read-only boundary: no write RPC, no signing, no key material, no ledger file creation, no real money.
2 repo evidence only; say unknown when the repo cannot show it.
3 Any item that needs a key, signing, disbursement or production writes is an ASK line, never a work assignment.
4 No credentials, no keys, no customer data, no mail bodies in any output.
5 Keep every line <=120 characters; never exceed 1300 characters in a seat task.
